note.en: The minutes list "Rafael Pineyro" twice in attendance and do not name Vice Mayor Puig-Corve. His vote is shown as yes because the minutes state "Meeting was called to order at 10:05 a.m. All members were present." and record this vote as "By consensus, motion passes unanimously".
note.es: El acta lista dos veces a "Rafael Pineyro" en la asistencia y no nombra al vicealcalde Puig-Corve. Su voto aparece a favor porque el acta dice "Meeting was called to order at 10:05 a.m. All members were present." (la sesión comenzó a las 10:05 a.m. con todos los miembros presentes) y registra esta votación como "By consensus, motion passes unanimously" (aprobada por unanimidad).
note.ht: Rapò reyinyon an mete "Rafael Pineyro" de fwa nan lis prezans lan epi li pa nonmen Vis Majistra Puig-Corve. Nou montre vòt li kòm wi paske rapò a di "Meeting was called to order at 10:05 a.m. All members were present." (reyinyon an te kòmanse a 10:05 a.m., tout manm yo te la) epi li anrejistre vòt sa a kòm "By consensus, motion passes unanimously" (pase alinanimite).
